subject: Truckload capacity still not recovering; CA diesel above $8
headline: No Truckload Capacity Rebound Yet as California Diesel Stays Above $8
script:
Capacity shows no sign of recovering, California diesel stays high, a border crackdown worries shippers, and fraud cases reach court.

Despite months of rate inflation, truckload data shows no sign of capacity recovering. Small carriers waiting for a market turn should keep planning around current conditions.

subject: Robinson nuclear verdict upheld; California diesel stays above $8
headline: Texas Judge Upholds C.H. Robinson Nuclear Verdict; California Diesel Holds Above $8
script:
A major broker verdict stands, California fuel stays painful, cargo crime cases hit trucking, and intermodal and port volumes run hot.

A Texas judge has affirmed the nuclear verdict against C.H. Robinson. That keeps liability risk front and center for anyone moving freight through brokers.
